sections.text:
Before starting a 
 gas turbine a visual inspection of the equipment by the shift engineer is 
 strongly recommended to ensure the operator that the unit is ready for 
 operation. Following guide lines for this inspection do not intend to be 
 complete but may help to prevent and reduce failures and increase the 
 reliability of the equipment

This document 
 initiated by eng. Ayman Mohamed Mohamed, tested by eng. Afifi Afifi Ebrahim 
 and eng. Mohamed Elsayed Ahmed, approved by eng.Mohamed 
 Salah Eldin Abd Elghafar general director.

This document 
 revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: CEPC quality control director, and 
 certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib: CEPC inspection 
 & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator

A 
work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, 
safety glasses is required.

items:

work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with

sections.text: Personal safety equipment, safety goggles, and rubber gloves and rubber apron.

items: Personal safety equipment, safety goggles, and rubber gloves and rubber apron.
Standard screwdrivers set
Press button 58b3 "Lamp test" all signal lamp must be light.

Press button 57b4 "function test" all signal light must be 
 flash and all horn and sirens must sound.

Press on secontic display button 109b1 "lamp test" (blue) all 
 secontic lamps must light.

Start the cooling pump (R5717) 
 with switch 8b1 "cooling oil pump" the cooling oil pump must run.

Check the current increase of approx. 12A on the 
 125 volt D.C consumption instrument (2g3).

Alarm "cooling oil pump" has to 
 come on.
Switch off the pump.

Check if selector switch on static starting equipment is in 
 the correct position

Check if 380 Volt starting c. b. (4a1) in panel k is in 
 service position
Check if 380 Volt c. b. (282a1) is in service position and on

Correct the status of hand valves of 
 the fuel transfer system from fuel tank up to the motor operated fuel valve 
 pos. GT5238 of the unit.

Correct the status of 
 hand valves of the gas supply system up to the motor operated main gas 
 valve pos. GT 8001 of the unit.
Check if both valves on the propane gas bottles open.

Ignition gas pressure must be > 1.5 bar, pointer 
 in automatic changeover valve in the green range.
Check that there is enough Turbotect in the additive tank

Check 
 that all drain valves on the fuel leakage tank are closed.

Check that both fuel filters 
 before fuel pump are ready for operation.

Check that all mechanical and 
 electrical maintenance works are finished.

Check that all manholes and 
 inspection-openings of the gas turbine are closed.

Check if cable to sparkplug is 
 connected properly.

Check 
 if all pipes, hoses to the burner are correctly connected and all bolts 
 tightened.

Remove 
 all tools, rags, papers etc. which may have been left by the maintenance crow.

Dry 
 up any fuel or oil leakages on the burner cover.

Check that lub. Oil filters of the unit are 
 ready for operation and selecting valve either in left or right position.

Check that earthing brushes on 
 generator shaft are properly on and generator shaft clean.
Check the pressure of generator cooling water system. Pressure must be at least 0.8 bar.

Check that 
 CO2 fire fighting system is operating.

sections.text: Check 11.5 kV Switchgear of the unit:

items:
Check that generator breaker 209 
 a1 (Z1) is in the service position.

Check that starting breaker 
 4a2(Z5) is in the service position.

Check 
 that feeder 
 breaker 209 a2 (Z3) is in the service position.

Connect temp. and load recorder 
 (Right switch to 1, left and middle switch to I).

Connect vibration recorder (left 
 switch to I, middle switch to R and right switch to 1).

Take all counter reading for 
 record purposes:
Starts.

Quick 
 loadings.

Operating 
 hours.
Correct hours.

Generator 
 active power.

Generator 
 reactive power.

Active power 
 auxiliary.

Make lamp and function test on 
 alarm Secontic indication panels according to Signalization Step.

Check if cooling oil pump is 
 operation according to Cooling Oil Pump Step
Clear all alarms.
